title: Desktop package test script is a no-op despite available smoke coverage

evidence.quote: "test": "echo 'desktop: covered by smoke test (pnpm smoke) and core tests'"
"smoke": "electron-vite build && DOCGIT_SMOKE=1 electron out/main/index.js && DOCGIT_BOOT_CHECK=1 electron out/main/index.js"

reasoning: The package has a real smoke script that exercises the Electron main, preload, renderer boot, and service paths, but the standard package test script only echoes a message and exits successfully. Any workflow that runs pnpm --filter @docgit/desktop test or relies on the detected test command will report success without running the desktop coverage it claims.
reproduction: Run pnpm --filter @docgit/desktop test; it exits 0 after printing the echo without building or launching the smoke checks.
recommendation: Make the desktop test script invoke the smoke script, or at minimum fail/redirect clearly so package-level test automation cannot silently skip the desktop app.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: There are no linked tests for this feature and the package's own test command does not execute the smoke test.
